IPO fallback is not used. a6: NYSE debut 11 Apr 2019. TechCrunch 11 Apr 2019: 'PagerDuty debuted on the New York Stock Exchange today'. April 2018 company PR already claimed they had 'exceeded the $100 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) milestone' (https://www.pagerduty.com/newsroom/2018-momentum-accelerate-reach/); IPO is the later, larger scale marker.
